title: fix(plugin-sharing)!: a share granted directly by a non-system caller is always a manual share
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no page under `skills/**` teaches the direct-grant door or its `source` / `sourceId` fields; the rule is stated in `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/sharing-service.mdx`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:非系统调用方直接授予的记录共享一律是手动共享;`grant` 对非 `'manual'` 的 `source` 或任何 `sourceId` 返回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`,不读不写。
- 为什么改:规则、团队与系统来源的共享只应由平台自身路径(系统上下文)写入,直接授权入口不应接受调用方自选来源。
- 风险与回滚:曾在直接授权请求里带非手动 `source` 或 `sourceId` 的客户端改收 400(BREAKING,changeset 写明迁移);系统路径与撤销规则不变;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`(`assertDirectGrantIsManual` 及其在 `grant` 非系统分支的调用点),`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.test.ts`(新 describe),`packages/qa/dogfood/test/direct-share-grant-is-manual.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/sharing-service.test.ts -t "a direct grant is always a manual share"`,预期 14 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A share a non-system caller grants is always a manual share.

- `SharingService.grant`, on the non-system path only, refuses an input whose `source` is present and is not `'manual'`, and an input that carries any `sourceId`, with `VALIDATION_FAILED` (REST 400) and a rule-level message. It refuses rather than rewrites, so a caller that sent a source learns it was not honoured. The check runs ahead of the authorization pre-flight, before anything is read or written.
- An absent `source` (`undefined` / `null`), or an explicit `'manual'` with no `sourceId`, is unchanged. The system path is unchanged.
- `POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/shares` is covered by the service rule as is; `packages/rest` is not edited.
- Docs: one rule sentence in `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/sharing-service.mdx` (Management authority).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-sharing` patch, `!`, BREAKING with Who moves, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

- `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.test.ts`, new top-level describe "a direct grant is always a manual share": refused for a non-system caller with `source` `'rule'` (with and without a `sourceId`), `'team'`, `'inherited'`, an unknown string, an empty string, a `sourceId` with no source and a `sourceId` with `'manual'`, each asserting `VALIDATION_FAILED`, no row and zero engine reads; the same for a caller without manage-shares rights. CONTROLS: no source, `null` source and `sourceId`, explicit `'manual'` (and its revoke), the system context writing a rule share with its `sourceId`, and the CONFLICT on a non-system revoke of that rule share.
- Two tests from the "no inert grants" suite that pinned a non-system grant carrying `sourceId` (and a non-manual `source`) were removed: they pinned the accepting branch this rule removes; a comment points to the new suite.
- `qa/dogfood/test/direct-share-grant-is-manual.dogfood.test.ts` (shared-showcase project): through the real REST door on the booted showcase, six refused shapes each answer 400 with nested `error.code` `VALIDATION_FAILED` and write no `sys_record_share` row; controls for no source (201, then the owner's DELETE 204), explicit `'manual'` (201), and a system-written rule share whose DELETE through the door is still 409 `CONFLICT`; and the generic data door on `sys_record_share` refusing the caller's create (405, no row).
- The rule evaluator's reconcile is unchanged and still materialises through `grant` under the system context: `plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule.test.ts` and the rest of the package pass.

## Acceptance notes

- The dogfood file sits outside the two edited source files' directories because only the booted runtime composes the REST door with the real service; it is registered in the `shared-showcase` project (`packages/qa/dogfood/vitest.config.ts`, one line).
- The client SDK's `shares.grant` options (`packages/client/src/index.ts`) still declare `source?` and `sourceId?`. After this rule only an absent `source` or `'manual'` with no `sourceId` is accepted there; narrowing that type is a separate change in `packages/client`, not made here.
